jon: Heads-up — PR #4987 needs legal + security redaction OK before merge. Targeting today's 4pm merge window. CI docs preview: https://ci.redwood.dev/preview/4987

alex: Thanks. Which sections are flagged? I only saw small example in SDK snippets.

jon: main ones: SDK snippet showing non-sanitized headers, and a migration example that includes a real kube secret name. Quick patch suggested below.

maria: @jon I can take legal review. Quick ask: replace exact secret identifiers with placeholders and add redaction note in the top of the doc.

kelly: Security agrees: change `apiKey=..."` lines to `apiKey=[REDACTED]`, remove real hostnames. Also need an ack on KMS usage statement.

alex: Patch pushed to branch `docs/4987-redact`. Small diff:
```diff
- client = new Client({ apiKey: "sk-prod-123" })
+ client = new Client({ apiKey: "[REDACTED]" })
```

sam: CI preview updated: https://ci.redwood.dev/preview/4987/sha-7a6b

ci-bot: docs preview build passed — staging link: https://staging.docs.redwood.dev/preview/4987 (checks: linter, linkcheck, accessibility)

maria: Legal OK on wording. Please add this sentence to the top: "This document has had identifying information redacted. Contact legal@redwood.com for review copies."

alex: Added legal sentence and updated examples. Ready for merge if security ok.

kelly: Security +1. One remaining ask: add a short note in the migration guide about rotating credentials after examples. I can gdoc comment or push.

jon: Great. I'll queue the merge for 16:00 PT. If anyone objects before 15:45 please shout.

docs-bot: scheduled merge for 16:00 PT by @jon. Auto-merge if CI green.

alex: Thanks all :tada:
